title: Score and lives
summary: Points per brick, three lives, “you win” and “game over”.
done: You saw variables, an “if … else” and an end function.

hello.text: In level 3: points, lives, and “You win” or “Game over” messages.

new.text: The starting blocks are now in the function “new game”: it is used at the start and to play again.

count.text: The **bricks** variable counts the bricks that are built…

win.text: … and we take one away for each broken brick. At 0, you win!

lost.text: [if … else]: if there are no lives left, the game is over; else, we serve again.

slow.text: Start **slow motion** to see the blocks light up.

watch.text: Let the ball fall: [change lives by -1] lights up.
watch.hint: Wait a little, or click “Restart” in the preview.

fast.text: Stop slow motion to play at normal speed.

toast.text: Show a short message when you win.
toast.hint: The block is in the Interface category.
